QuestInfo.name: Path of the Great Protector
QuestInfo.0: Everyone is buzzing about the new Great Protector competition. Get the details from Cassandra.
QuestInfo.1: What does it take to become a Great Protector?
QuestInfo.2: Use your Training Stone to focus the power from your training efforts. Check where you can charge your Training Gauge in the <Training Field Info> by clicking the Event Notifier on the left side of the screen.

0.0: Hey, I've been looking for you! You're probably heard that monsters all over Maple World are getting stronger. I was trying to think of some way to keep people safe, and it finally came to me! We just need to make everyone stronger! So, I'm holding a contest to see which Mapler can train themselves the most. The one who makes the most progress will get a trophy at the Legends Awards! Doesn't that sound like fun?

no.0: If we're gonna keep Maple World safe, we all need to get stronger. I don't want to see you left behind.

yes.0: Good choice! Okay, here's your Training Journal and a Training Stone. Keep the Stone in your Set-Up Inventory, and hunt monsters in certain areas to fill up its gauge. Once it's full, you can activate your Great Fortitude skill, to bust up monsters even faster! Click the Event Notifier and select <Training Field Info> to check where you can charge your gauge.

default.0: Make sure you're over Level 10, and have empty slots in your Equip, ETC, Use, and Set-up Inventory tabs.
